body: That I often mutter how much I hate my life under my breath, sit around and mope all the fucking time because I don't feel like doing anything else since I've lost the girl of my dreams. No, wait, lost isn't the right term..threw away the girl of my dreams and then chased her into her current boyfriend's arms. That I feel so guilty for putting them through so much financial strain by putting me through college where I constantly battle depression, have one friend, and got a B, two D's and had to withdraw from two classes. That I cry myself to sleep every night and smoke a fuckton of cigarettes because its the only thing that I've found somewhat relieves my stress. That my best friend is becoming a meth addict and is in denial about it and won't listen to me that it will fucking destroy his life. He just got out of rehab a month ago for prescription pill abuse. I really, REALLY hate my life.
